description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various emotions, comparing their relative proportions. The chart is divided into six slices, each representing a distinct emotion. The slices are labeled as Frustration (blue, 25.1%), Neutral (light blue, 23.1%), Happiness (yellow, 8.1%), Excitement (red, 14.1%), Sadness (brown, 14.7%), and Anger (green, 14.9%). The percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, and there is no legend present in the chart. The slices are not visually emphasized or offset, and they appear to be arranged in no particular order by size.
